name: Дебютний тренажер: використання переваги
description:
If the opening goes well, it provides an opening advantage. Sometimes the opening goes so well that tactical opportunities arise. At times like this we no longer want to worry about principles, but immediately want to seize the opportunity!

Look at the first example. Here Black has broken the silver rules by touching the f-pawn early. The situation is now so serious for Black that White can immediately take advantage. With a beautiful knight sacrifice, White can decisively open the lines to the black king. The 

What do you have to do?

Look for moves that improve your position, but also consider if there is a tactical combination available that immediately leads to a large advantage.

examples.pgn: {[#]} 3. Nxe5 ! fxe5 4. Qh5+ Ke7 5. Qxe5+ Kf7 6. Bc4+ d5 7. Bxd5+ Kg6 8. h4 ! h6 9. Bxb7 ! Bxb7 10. Qf5# *
examples.text: Black played the opening poorly by playing the f-pawn too early. Black thus violates the silver rules and can be punished immediately. White has the wonderful move 1.Nxe5!! which opens the lines to the black king. It is important that White wins after 1…fxe5 2.Qh5+ g6 3.Qxe5+ Ne7 4.Qxh8. Black can also step forward with the king with 2…Ke7. White can then win in several ways. In this example you see a convincing variation that leads to mate.

examples.pgn: {[#]} 6. Bxf7+ ! Kxf7 7. Ng5+ Kg8 8. Ne6 Qe8 9. Nxc7 {[%cal Gc7a8,Gc7e8]} Qd8 10. Nxa8 *
examples.text: Here too, White has a nice combination. 1.Bxf7! is very strong. The idea is that White wants to trap the black queen with Ng5+ followed by Ne6. A variation is 1…Kxf7 2.Ng5+ Kg8 3.Ne6 Qe8 4.Nxc7 after which White forks the black queen and rook. White thus gains a decisive material advantage.
